decisions.title: Herbário
decisions.metaphor:
HERBARIUM: a scrolling tray of pressed specimens. Anything outside the reading
 band is only grain; what you stop on resolves into a drawing, and one tap pins
 it to your collection.
decisions.reason: mt slop de ia, mt informação inútil

decisions.title: Fechar posição
decisions.metaphor:
POSITION: close part of a trading position by dragging, and watch the result
 roll into place before you commit.
decisions.reason: bom mas o fundo ficou ruim, e ta um colorido feio, conseguimos melhorar e limpar?

decisions.title: Trilha
decisions.metaphor:
TRAIL: a step-by-step flow where only one step is open at a time, finished
 steps slide aside like abacus beads, and nothing is ever lost.
decisions.reason: inútil e mt slop de ia, não serve pro catálogo

decisions.title: Arranjo
decisions.metaphor: ARRANGE: one word, five arrangements, turned like a kaleidoscope barrel.
decisions.reason: a ideia é legla, mas as cores são slop, e poderia ter uma forma menos blocada pra apenas 4 caracters? tenta escrever visant e faça ser nível visant

decisions.title: Perfil de rota
decisions.metaphor:
PROFILE: read a route off the shape of its terrain, with a clinometer that
 hangs from the cursor and swings to the grade under it.
decisions.reason: tem mt label aparecendo , limpar

decisions.title: Compass
decisions.metaphor:
COMPASS: a needle that swings toward the pointer, the way a real one swings
 toward north: past it, then back, then still.
decisions.reason: poderia ser com efeitos de profundidado ou perspectiva interativar com hover, pra dar um movimento e profundidade pro componente

decisions.title: Loupe
decisions.metaphor: LOUPE: a magnifier over print too small to read.
decisions.reason: mt obvio

decisions.title: Level
decisions.metaphor: LEVEL: a word filled with liquid that stays level while the word tilts.
decisions.reason: cópia descancarada, pense numa forma mais shader fluida drip de fazer isso, minimal e elegante

decisions.title: Ratchet
decisions.metaphor:
RATCHET: scrolling winds a toothed wheel that only turns one way, the pawl
 riding up each tooth's slope and falling off its steep face.
decisions.reason: dahora, mas faltou ivda, tem como ser mais metálico a saw? ou dar mais vida ao vetor

decisions.title: Stamp
decisions.metaphor:
STAMP: a rubber stamp. Holding it down soaks the pad, letting go leaves the
 impression, and the longer the hold, the darker the ink.
decisions.reason: paia

decisions.title: Shutter
decisions.metaphor:
SHUTTER: a lens iris. Pressing snaps the blades shut; letting go opens them one
 stop tighter than before, and the light behind pays for it.
decisions.reason: paia

decisions.title: Raking light
decisions.metaphor:
RAKE: a lamp held low over blind-embossed paper, where a raised word is only
 ever visible as the shadow and the highlight the light gives it.
decisions.reason: esse ficou foda, add mais textura, grain etc, pra dar mais vida e organicidade

decisions.title: Pastas
decisions.metaphor:
PASTAS: section tabs as hanging folders in a drawer. Drag up or down across
 the stack to thumb through it; the folders in front drop forward until the
 one you want stands open.
decisions.reason: dahora, poderia ter mais respiro visual e melhorar a emenda dos shapes pra ficar mais arredondado e suave

decisions.title: Leitor de fuso
decisions.metaphor: ZONE: pick a time zone by sliding a strip of film under a reader.
decisions.reason: tá massa, poderia ter mais umas opcoes de layout tipo numero / list - e ux de dragg vertical scroll

decisions.title: Teclas de modo
decisions.metaphor: MODE: pick how a home battery behaves with a bank of latching push keys.
decisions.reason: seria massa se mudasse o tema levemente conforme a opcao

decisions.title: Louver
decisions.metaphor:
LOUVER: scrolling turns the slats of a window blind, and the bars of sunlight
 they let onto the wall widen and narrow.
decisions.reason: meio inutil, mas ta dahora o conceito, poderia ter mais profundidade

decisions.title: Canhoto
decisions.metaphor: CANHOTO: confirm attendance by tearing the stub off a ticket.
decisions.reason: precisa melhorar a animacao de rasgando, e ter feedback visual depois de rasgar - deixe mais burilado e refinado no design end to end

decisions.title: Detent
decisions.metaphor:
DETENT: a steel ball in a tray with five dimples. Tilt the tray and the ball
 leans against the wall of its dimple; tilt past the lip and it drops into the
 next one with a click, never resting between two.
decisions.reason: dahora a ideia, mas precisa melhorar a animacao e birular o design end to end, principalemnte da bolinha de metal q ta mt cru e nao ˜gira~ ainda, mt fake e nao fliuido

decisions.title: Governor
decisions.metaphor:
GOVERNOR: a flyball governor, the brass regulator on a steam engine. Two heavy
 balls hang from a spinning shaft; spin it faster and they swing out, lifting a
 collar along the shaft. Slow it down and they fall back.
decisions.reason: visual chapado/vetor cru (dois palitos e bolinhas 2D sem 3D/textura), gesto desconectado da resposta e metáfora abstrata sem função real em UI

decisions.title: Alcance
decisions.metaphor: ALCANCE: pick a plan by how much you need, not by its name.
decisions.reason: visual sem graça com cara de form padrão (barrinhas cinzas empilhadas sem presença de objeto físico) e caso de uso forçado (ninguém escolhe plano medindo folga num paquímetro)

decisions.title: Despacho
decisions.metaphor:
DESPACHO: triage a pending operational queue by flicking physical index cards
 left (hold) or right (approve), like a tactile review deck on a desk.
decisions.reason: esse já tem po, faz outro

decisions.title: Toggle
decisions.metaphor:
TOGGLE: an over-center toggle switch mounted on a brushed plate. Push the
 knurled bat handle against its spring; cross the center cam and it snaps to
 the opposite stop, throwing its shadow and specular ridge across the bezel.
decisions.reason: precisa ser mais minimal, suave, tem mt linha e ta meio tosco

decisions.title: Iris
decisions.metaphor:
IRIS: a camera aperture stopped down over a redacted number. Drag to spread
 the blades and the light they let through brings the hidden value into
 focus — the same gesture a lens uses to let more of the scene in.
decisions.reason: svg mt porco: lâminas em triângulo chapado, nada de nível hardware

decisions.title: Encaixe
decisions.metaphor:
ENCAIXE: a dovetail joint cut from one solid block. Two halves split along a
 zigzag seam; drag the right half back and the teeth find their exact mates,
 locking the joint — the same seam the NM monogram thickens into a mark.
decisions.reason: svg mt porco: blocos chapados com listras, nada de nível hardware
